OpenSCManagerA.description: Opens the service control manager; meaningful only combined with OpenServiceA/ControlService to stop an AV/EDR service.

OpenSCManagerW.description: Unicode variant of OpenSCManagerA; meaningful only combined with service manipulation APIs.

OpenServiceA.description: Opens a handle to a service; meaningful only combined with ControlService or ChangeServiceConfigA to tamper with a security service.

OpenServiceW.description: Unicode variant of OpenServiceA; meaningful only combined with service manipulation APIs.

ControlService.description: Sends a control code (e.g. SERVICE_CONTROL_STOP) to a service; meaningful only combined with OpenSCManager/OpenService targeting an AV/EDR service.

ChangeServiceConfigA.description: Reconfigures a service (e.g. start type to disabled); meaningful only combined with OpenServiceA targeting a security service.

ChangeServiceConfigW.description: Unicode variant of ChangeServiceConfigA; meaningful only combined with OpenServiceW.

DeleteService.description: Deletes a service outright; rare enough in legitimate software to flag standalone, often used to remove AV/EDR services.

OpenProcess.description: Opens a handle to a process; meaningful only combined with TerminateProcess targeting an AV/EDR process.

TerminateProcess.description: Terminates a process; ubiquitous, meaningful only combined with OpenProcess targeting a security process.

RegCreateKeyExA.description: Creates or opens a registry key; meaningful only combined with RegSetValueExA to write Defender/AV policy values.

RegCreateKeyExW.description: Unicode variant of RegCreateKeyExA; meaningful only combined with RegSetValueExW.

RegSetValueExA.description: Sets a registry value; meaningful only combined with RegCreateKeyExA -- likely writing DisableAntiSpyware/DisableRealtimeMonitoring.

RegSetValueExW.description: Unicode variant of RegSetValueExA; meaningful only combined with RegCreateKeyExW.

RegDeleteValueA.description: Deletes a registry value; too generic alone, notable only when confirmed against a security-product registry path via strings.

OpenEventLogA.description: Opens a handle to an event log; meaningful only combined with ClearEventLogA to wipe logs.

OpenEventLogW.description: Unicode variant of OpenEventLogA; meaningful only combined with ClearEventLogW.

ClearEventLogA.description: Clears a Windows event log; escalated to CRITICAL only when combined with OpenEventLogA (confirms a targeted log was opened first).

EvtClearLog.description: Clears a Windows event log using the Event Log API; commonly used to remove traces after malicious activity.

AuditPolicySetSubCategoriesEx.description: Modifies audit policy subcategories directly; rarely used outside security tooling, commonly abused to disable specific audit event generation.

AmsiInitialize.description: Initializes an AMSI context; meaningful only combined with AmsiScanBuffer and VirtualProtect in an in-memory AMSI patch.

AmsiScanBuffer.description: References the AMSI scan function directly; escalated only when combined with AmsiInitialize and VirtualProtect, indicating an in-memory patch attempt.

VirtualProtect.description: Changes memory page protection; ubiquitous, meaningful only combined with AmsiScanBuffer or EtwEventWrite to patch bytes in a loaded module.

EtwEventWrite.description: References the ETW event write function; meaningful only combined with VirtualProtect, indicating a patch to suppress trace events.

NtTraceEvent.description: Native ETW tracing function; meaningful only combined with VirtualProtect for ETW suppression via patching.

CoInitializeEx.description: COM initialization; meaningful only combined with CoCreateInstance for INetFwPolicy2-based firewall manipulation.

CoCreateInstance.description: Instantiates a COM object; meaningful only combined with CoInitializeEx -- pivot for firewall policy (HNetCfg.FwPolicy2) manipulation.

Windows Defender.description: Windows Defender product name string, typically used to target its process, service, or registry keys.

WinDefend.description: Windows Defender service name, used with service control APIs to stop/disable it.

MsMpEng.exe.description: Windows Defender antimalware service executable name; used for process enumeration/termination.

SepMasterService.description: Symantec Endpoint Protection master service name.

ekrn.exe.description: ESET antivirus kernel service process name.

SAVAdminService.exe.description: Sophos Anti-Virus administration service process name.

CSFalconService.exe.description: CrowdStrike Falcon EDR service process name.

elastic-endpoint.exe.description: Elastic Endpoint Security EDR agent process name.

HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Win.description: Windows Defender group policy registry path, used to write DisableAntiSpyware and related policy values.

HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows Defen.description: Windows Defender Real-Time Protection registry path, used to write DisableRealtimeMonitoring.

DisableAntiSpyware.description: Registry value name that fully disables Windows Defender when set to 1 under policy.

DisableRealtimeMonitoring.description: Registry value name that disables Windows Defender real-time protection when set to 1.

amsi.dll.description: Antimalware Scan Interface library name; referenced when dynamically resolving AmsiScanBuffer for patching.

HNetCfg.FwPolicy2.description: COM ProgID for the Windows Firewall policy object (INetFwPolicy2), used to disable firewall profiles programmatically.

netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state.description: Embedded command line that disables the Windows Firewall across all profiles.

netsh firewall set opmode disable.description: Embedded legacy netsh command line that disables the Windows Firewall.

wevtutil cl.description: Embedded wevtutil command line used to clear a Windows event log.

auditpol /set.description: Embedded auditpol command line used to modify or disable audit policy subcategories.

sc.exe stop WinDefend.description: Embedded sc.exe command line that stops the Windows Defender service.

sc stop WinDefend.description: Embedded sc command line (without .exe extension) that stops the Windows Defender service.

Sysmon.description: Sysmon service name; often targeted by malware attempting to disable security monitoring.

Sysmon64.exe.description: Sysmon monitoring executable name, commonly targeted by service/process termination attempts.

vssadmin delete shadows.description: Command used to delete Volume Shadow Copies and prevent system recovery.

vssadmin.exe delete shadows.description: Command used to delete Volume Shadow Copies and prevent system recovery.

wmic shadowcopy delete.description: WMIC command used to delete Volume Shadow Copies.

wmic.exe shadowcopy delete.description: WMIC command used to delete Volume Shadow Copies.

wbadmin delete catalog.description: Command used to remove Windows backup catalog information.

wbadmin.exe delete catalog.description: Command used to remove Windows backup catalog information.

wuauserv.description: Windows Update service name; targeted by some malware to disable system updates.

amsi_scanbuffer_patch.description: MOV EAX, 0x80070057; RET -- classic in-memory patch that forces AmsiScanBuffer to always return E_INVALIDARG, bypassing AMSI.

combinations.name: AV/EDR service termination via SCM
combinations.description: Opens the SCM and a specific service, then sends a control code -- consistent with stopping an AV/EDR service.

combinations.name: AV/EDR service termination via SCM (Unicode)
combinations.description: Unicode variant of SCM-based service termination.

combinations.name: AV/EDR service auto-start disabling
combinations.description: Opens a service and reconfigures it -- consistent with setting a security service's start type to disabled.

combinations.name: AV/EDR service auto-start disabling (Unicode)
combinations.description: Unicode variant of service auto-start disabling.

combinations.name: AV/EDR process termination
combinations.description: Opens and terminates a process -- combined with security-product process name strings, indicates AV/EDR process killing.

combinations.name: Registry-based Defender/security policy tampering
combinations.description: Creates a registry key and writes a value -- likely setting DisableAntiSpyware or DisableRealtimeMonitoring.

combinations.name: Registry-based Defender/security policy tampering (Unicode)
combinations.description: Unicode variant of registry-based Defender tampering.

combinations.name: Windows Event Log clearing
combinations.description: Opens a specific event log handle and clears it -- deliberate log wipe rather than incidental API presence.

combinations.name: Windows Event Log clearing (Unicode)
combinations.description: Unicode variant of Windows Event Log clearing.

combinations.name: AMSI bypass via in-memory patch
combinations.description: Initializes AMSI, references AmsiScanBuffer, and changes memory protection -- the full pattern of patching AmsiScanBuffer in memory to bypass AMSI scanning.

combinations.name: ETW tracing suppression via memory patch
combinations.description: References EtwEventWrite and changes memory protection -- consistent with patching the ETW write function to stub it out and suppress telemetry.

combinations.name: COM-based firewall policy manipulation
combinations.description: Initializes COM and instantiates an object -- required to obtain an INetFwPolicy2 instance (HNetCfg.FwPolicy2) for programmatic firewall disabling.
